scope: PE cipher samples only (DES and RC4 families)

evidence_contract.description: Defines the exact evidence fields that future IDA/Ghidra/static extraction must collect for DES and RC4 PE cipher samples. Each field specifies what to extract, how it maps to training metadata, and validation preconditions.

algorithm_marker_evidence.description: Identify the cipher algorithm from static artifacts

markers: DES initial permutation table (IP table, 64 bytes at known offsets)
DES S-box tables (8 S-boxes, each 64 entries of 4-bit values)
DES permutation tables (P-box, expansion E, PC-1, PC-2)
DES Feistel round structure (16 rounds of expansion, XOR, S-box, permutation)
Constant: 0x0E329B23 (DES S1 box first row checksum) or equivalent
DES.extraction_method: IDA: search for 64-byte constant arrays matching IP/S-box patterns; strings: search for 'DES' or 'des' in binary strings; imports: check for CryptEncrypt/CryptDeriveKey with CALG_DES

markers: RC4 KSA (Key Scheduling Algorithm): swap loop with 256-iteration initialization
Constant: 256 (S-box size) used in loop bound
Pattern: XOR with S-box indexed value in tight loop
RC4.extraction_method: IDA: search for 256-iteration initialization loop with swap pattern; strings: search for 'RC4' or 'rc4'; imports: check for CryptEncrypt with CALG_RC4

algorithm_marker_evidence.confidence_threshold: HIGH when 2+ markers found; MEDIUM when 1 marker found; LOW when no markers

string_evidence.description: Extract printable strings that indicate cipher type, mode, or key material
string_evidence.extraction_method: existing static_feature_extractor.py string extraction; IDA strings window; `strings` command output

constant_table_evidence.description: Extract cipher-specific constant tables from .rdata or .data sections

DES.extraction_method: IDA: identify 64-byte aligned constant arrays in .rdata; cross-reference with Feistel round function

tables: S-box (256-byte permutation array, initialized to identity at KSA start)
No fixed constant tables beyond the 0x00-0xFF identity initialization
RC4.extraction_method: IDA: identify 256-byte array with identity initialization; trace KSA loop that swaps entries

import_api_evidence.description: Extract Windows API imports related to cryptography
import_api_evidence.extraction_method: IDA imports view; PE import table parsing via existing local_reverse_inventory

input_source_evidence.description: Identify where the plaintext input enters the cipher pipeline
input_source_evidence.extraction_method: IDA: trace data flow from input API to cipher function entry; cross-reference with string evidence

key_source_evidence.description: Identify where the encryption key originates

key_characteristics: May be derived from password via CryptDeriveKey or custom KDF
May be derived from password or hardcoded

key_source_evidence.extraction_method: IDA: trace key parameter to cipher function; check for CryptDeriveKey or direct key buffer

iv_mode_padding_evidence.description: Identify cipher mode, initialization vector, and padding scheme
iv_mode_padding_evidence.extraction_method: IDA: check API mode parameter; trace IV parameter; identify padding logic after final block

ciphertext_source_evidence.description: Identify where ciphertext is written and its format
fields_to_extract: ciphertext_length (same as input for stream ciphers, padded for block ciphers)
ciphertext_source_evidence.extraction_method: IDA: trace cipher function output to write/compare location

comparison_output_sink_evidence.description: Identify the comparison point where ciphertext is verified
comparison_output_sink_evidence.extraction_method: IDA: identify compare/cmp instructions after cipher output; trace branch targets

candidate_input_domain_evidence.description: Define the bounded input domain for candidate generation

input_domain: key_space: 2^56 (infeasible for brute force without constraints)
plaintext_space: depends on input source (typically printable ASCII or known format)
constrained_key: if hardcoded or derived from short password, key space reduces dramatically
known_plaintext: if comparison target is known, chosen-plaintext may apply
DES.domain_bounds: requires key_source_evidence to determine if brute-force is feasible

input_domain: key_space: depends on key length (typically 5-16 bytes for password-derived)
keystream_recovery: if known plaintext at known position, keystream bytes can be recovered
fluhrer_mantin_shamir: applicable if related keys used (unlikely in CTF)
RC4.domain_bounds: requires key_source_evidence to determine key length and derivation

candidate_input_domain_evidence.extraction_method: derived from input_source_evidence and key_source_evidence; not directly extracted by static tools

validation_preconditions.description: Preconditions that must be met before attempting sample solution
preconditions: key_source_evidence must identify key origin (hardcoded, password-derived, or unknown)
comparison_output_sink_evidence must locate the comparison point
candidate_input_domain_evidence must establish bounded domain or confirm unbounded
blocker_conditions: algorithm_marker_evidence confidence = LOW: cannot confirm cipher algorithm
key_source_evidence = unknown and no hardcoded key: key recovery may be infeasible
comparison_output_sink_evidence = missing: cannot determine success criteria

structured_evidence_mapping_plan.description: How the evidence contract maps tool output into training metadata and later StructuredEvidence

mapping_steps.output: algorithm markers, constant tables, function boundaries, cross-references
string indicators, import table, section layout
input buffer, key buffer, IV, ciphertext buffer, comparison point
mapping_steps.mapping: input_source_evidence + key_source_evidence + iv_mode_padding_evidence + ciphertext_source_evidence + comparison_output_sink_evidence → data_flow_contract

structured_evidence_mapping_plan.structured_evidence_schema_note: The StructuredEvidence type is the project's standard for recording extracted evidence. This profile defines what fields future static-triage runs must populate. The actual StructuredEvidence conversion happens in the triage round, not in this planning round.

future_static_triage_sequence.description: Run bounded static triage on desenc_0e0b5203 (first DES target)
future_static_triage_sequence.tool: IDA / IDAPython via existing tool runners
future_static_triage_sequence.expected_outcome: confirm DES algorithm, locate S-box tables, identify key source
future_static_triage_sequence.decision_after: if DES confirmed and key source identified → proceed to key recovery; if algorithm uncertain → expand marker search

future_static_triage_sequence.description: Run bounded static triage on rc4enc_3480917d (first RC4 target)
future_static_triage_sequence.tool: IDA / IDAPython via existing tool runners
future_static_triage_sequence.expected_outcome: confirm RC4 algorithm, locate KSA loop, identify key source
future_static_triage_sequence.decision_after: if RC4 confirmed and key source identified → proceed to key recovery; if algorithm uncertain → expand marker search

future_static_triage_sequence.description: Based on step 1 and 2 results, run data flow analysis on confirmed samples
future_static_triage_sequence.expected_outcome: locate input, key, ciphertext, and comparison points for each confirmed sample
future_static_triage_sequence.decision_after: if all data flow points located → proceed to candidate domain analysis; if key source unknown → consider runtime probe

future_static_triage_sequence.expected_outcome: determine if bounded solution is feasible for each sample
future_static_triage_sequence.decision_after: if domain bounded → schedule solver round; if unbounded → mark as BLOCKED with specific blocker

future_static_triage_sequence.description: Apply learned patterns to remaining DES/RC4 PE samples
future_static_triage_sequence.evidence_to_collect: same evidence contract fields, using patterns from first targets
future_static_triage_sequence.expected_outcome: triage remaining 3 DES and 1 RC4 samples using confirmed patterns
future_static_triage_sequence.decision_after: update training status for all cipher samples

DES.rationale: first DES PE sample in inventory; name suggests 'DES encrypt' which provides algorithm hint
DES.expected_evidence: DES S-box tables, IP/FP permutation tables, Feistel round structure
DES.triage_round_prerequisite: this cipher_static_evidence_profile must be accepted first

RC4.rationale: first RC4 PE sample in inventory; name suggests 'RC4 encrypt' which provides algorithm hint
RC4.expected_evidence: RC4 KSA initialization loop, PRGA swap-and-output loop, S-box identity init
RC4.triage_round_prerequisite: this cipher_static_evidence_profile must be accepted first

non_goals: solving any DES or RC4 sample in this round
running IDA, Ghidra, debugger, emulator, or any runtime tool
modifying solver logic, tool runners, harness behavior, or raw sample files
marking any cipher sample as solved, blocked, or triaged
implementing a new IDA/Ghidra interface (existing ones must be reused)

evidence_contract covers all required fields for DES and RC4
